_note: Phase checkpoints, modelled on the multilevel course's exams.json. Questions are drawn from the named lessons' quiz arrays rather than duplicated, so there is one source of truth per question.

exams.title: Orientation Checkpoint
exams.description: A self-check on the Atlas and the six shapes. Not graded — use it to confirm the sorting reflex works before going deeper.

exams.title: Shapes Checkpoint
exams.description: Covers the individual shapes: anomaly detection, forecasting, labels from tables and pixels, structure, language, decisions. Each question names the shape's classical comparator or its evaluation debt.

exams.title: Judgement Checkpoint
exams.description: Evaluation and governance. The half of the course that decides the other half — discrimination vs calibration, PPV at prevalence, leakage, and the reporting frameworks.
